artworks.title: First Leaves—Spring in Washington, St. John's
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a forested area with tall trees casting shadows on the ground. In the background, there is a structure partially visible behind the trees, featuring columns. A fence is seen in the distance. The etching displays detailed cross-hatching creating texture and depth. The color scheme is a monochrome sepia tone.

artworks.title: The Writing Desk
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the back sitting at a desk in a full profile view from the waist up. She is slightly leaning forward with her arms resting on the desk. Her hair is styled in a neat bun. She is wearing a long-sleeved dress or blouse. The background features a window with lush foliage, potted plants, and vases on the window sill. A wooden chair is below her, and the desk is cluttered with papers and writing tools. More indoor plants are visible in the background.

artworks.title: Rainy Day, Williamsburg, Virginia
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1930)
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of an old building surrounded by trees. The building has a central cupola with a weather vane, with another structure visible behind it. The foreground includes two figures walking away from the building. The etching uses intricate lines and cross-hatching to create texture and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, relying on line density for contrast and dimension.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up. He is facing forward with a serious expression. The man has short, wavy hair and distinct facial features. He is wearing a light-colored garment with a dark bowtie at the collar. In his hand, he holds multiple thin objects. The background features patterned papers or art prints.

artworks.title: The Steps
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman descending a staircase. She is positioned sideways, facing left, with her right hand resting on the stair's railing. Her head is slightly turned downwards, and she has dark hair styled in a bun. She is wearing a long, flowing dress with a pattern that blends into the environmental tones. The staircase is surrounded by lush foliage, indicating a garden setting. Shadows of leaves fall on the stairs, suggesting sunlight filtering through trees. The background is filled with dense plant life, with leaves and branches framing the scene.

artworks.title: Rain Drops and Surf
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure standing by the shore with arms raised. The figure stands in shallow water, with waves crashing around them. The sky is filled with dramatic clouds. The drawing is detailed and intricate, using crosshatching to create shadows and depth.

artworks.title: Devils Way, Algiers
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an arched stone entrance with steps and figures draped in robes. The scene depicts a finely detailed architectural structure with an arched doorway leading into a shadowy corridor. The entrance is framed by ancient, weathered columns and stones. The lighting is dramatic, emphasizing the textures of the stone. Figures wearing robes are placed around the entrance, adding a sense of scale and activity to the architectural setting. The intricate play of light and shadow suggests a traditional art style, focusing on depth and atmospheric perspective.

artworks.title: Grey's Quick Step
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on folded wove sheet music
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1953)
artworks.description: The image shows military figures standing in formation near a wooded area. A path leads to the left, flanked by a wooden fence and a sign that reads "HAVERHILL". The landscape behind the soldiers features buildings suggesting a village or town. The artwork is a detailed engraving with fine lines conveying texture and depth in dark tones.

artworks.title: November
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image displays a rural landscape with a cluster of buildings, including a large barn or farmhouse slightly to the left of center. The horizon is low, with the structures and bare trees extending into a sky filled with intricate lines indicating a textured, potentially overcast atmosphere. The detailed lines suggest an etching technique, creating a monochrome image emphasizing textures. In the foreground, rough grassy terrain with scattered sheep grazing is visible, adding depth. Beyond the buildings, textured land and leafless trees continue, enhancing the tranquil atmosphere. The color palette is muted with sepia tones and dark lines, imparting a vintage feel.

artworks.title: The Death of George Washington
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image displays four individuals, with one person lying on a bed. The individual on the bed is shown from the waist up, with their head on a pillow, wearing a white head covering and white clothing. Three other individuals are standing next to the bed. One person is bending over the individual on the bed, with gray hair, wearing a green coat with a black pattern, a pink waistcoat, yellow knee-length pants, and black boots. Another person, standing farther away, has white hair and wears a long green coat. The fourth person, seated on the left, has a feathered headdress, a red band, and a white garment with a red lining and a medallion. This person is holding a pipe. In the background, there are draped curtains with fringe and a decorative circular emblem featuring stars and potentially an eagle emblem. A wooden window or paneling can be seen behind the curtains.

artworks.title: Shanties on the Harlem
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of rustic houses near a waterbody from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is low in the image, meeting a strip of land in the distance against a pale sky. The brushstrokes are linear and detailed, showing wooden textures and shingles. The color palette is sepia-toned, creating a warm, antiquated feel. In the foreground, figures are present on a path and near the water's edge. The scene is captured with precise line work, typical of an etching or drawing.

artworks.title: St. Gervais, Paris
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows an urban riverside scene. On the left, a bridge extends diagonally across the canvas, casting a shadow on the water below. Near us, two figures are by the water's edge on wooden planks. In the middle, small boats are docked along the water. The horizon has tall buildings with a church or clock tower. The image uses etching technique with fine lines to create texture and depth, in varying shades of sepia and dark brown. In the distance, more architectural details are visible.

artworks.title: Buried with Him by Baptism
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a baptism in a river. The image shows two figures standing in the water, surrounded by the text "Jordan." Above them, beams of light emanate from the sky, where a dove-like figure appears amidst radiant rays. In the sky, clouds are populated by angelic beings looking upon the scene. The landscape includes trees and buildings along the riverbank. An inscription states, "He is my beloved Son - hear ye him." On the opposite bank, a group of figures stands observing the event. At the bottom, the text reads "BURIED WITH HIM BY BAPTISM." The drawing features intricate line work and shading.

artworks.title: His Excellency John Hancock, Esquire
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1957)
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait focused on the upper half of a person's body, particularly the face and chest. The person has a three-quarter profile, with a composed expression and distinct facial features. The individual has formal, pompadour-styled hair and is wearing an ornate coat with detailed embroidery. The background consists of an oval shape with a decorative pattern, and there is an arrangement of drapery with leaf motifs above the portrait. The lower part of the image contains cursive writing and a decorative crest design.

artworks.title: Old Boat-House
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image shows a busy dockside scene viewed from a waterfront perspective. The horizon is low with distant land visible across the water. The dock area to the right is filled with wooden structures on piles, including buildings with signs like "SPARS" and "BOATS TO LET." Tall masts from docked vessels rise vertically. The style appears to be an etching with fine, intricate lines. The color palette is muted and monochromatic with sepia tones. Rocks and small ripples are visible on the calm water, with people in small boats further out. The background blends into the pale sky.

artworks.title: The Music Room
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown-black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1930)
artworks.description: The image shows three people seated at a round table with a tablecloth, illuminated by a lamp. The person on the left is reclining in an armchair, with short hair. The middle person is reading a book, with indistinct facial features. The person on the right is seated at the table, engrossed in reading, wearing a dress. The lamp on the table illuminates papers and the individuals. In the background, there are framed objects leaning against the wall, beside large windows.

artworks.title: Bibi Lalouette
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: The image displays an etching featuring an individual seen from the side, emphasizing the head, torso, and upper part of the legs. The person is seated with a slight leftward body turn, maintaining an upright posture. They have curly hair and a delicate facial profile with a prominent nose. The clothing is depicted with fine lines and shading, and they are holding a small, dark object on their lap. The background is simple, directing attention to the figure. The piece is signed by Whistler in the bottom right corner, along with the date 1859.

artworks.title: La Vieille aux Loques
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated in a small interior space resembling a pantry or storeroom. The person is seated with their body slightly hunched forward, head bowed and facial features obscured. They are wearing a long-sleeved dress with a bonnet. Various household objects such as baskets and jars are around them, with shelves filled with containers and food items. Sacks are also on the floor. The surroundings are depicted in an intricate etching style, creating a dimly lit, cozy atmosphere.

artworks.title: Longshoremen
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: The image shows several individuals sitting from the waist up. A man with a headscarf and jacket is on the left, a central male figure in a hat and jacket is in the middle, and another person with a pipe is on the right. Next to them, a possible parent and child are engrossed in a book. The figures vary in facial hair and wear casual attire. The background features wooden panels and benches, hinting at an indoor setting like a tavern or communal space. The image is etched in a linear style with high contrasts.

artworks.title: Nursemaid and Child
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman reclining on the ground, leaning against a tree or similar natural structure. She has long hair tied back, delicate facial features, and is wearing a patterned garment with a scarf around her neck. In the background are trees, a few figures or animals, and a detailed sky and surroundings.

artworks.title: Thames Police
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a riverside scene with a bustling dock area. The composition features a line of old buildings and ships along the river bank extending into the distance. The sky has gentle brushstrokes creating a subtle texture, suggesting lightly clouded skies. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia and brown. Figures are engaged in activities by the water, with small boats spread across the scene. In the distance, tall ships with masts stand against the row of buildings, and a sign reading "Thames Police" is visible on one of the structures.

artworks.title: The Unsafe Tenement
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: The image features a view looking slightly upward at an old, rustic building. The focus is on the structure itself, displaying detailed textures created through etching. The building is depicted with intricate lines, conveying the appearance of weathered wood and aged masonry. Near an entrance, a figure is seen standing in a shadowed area, adding depth and scale to the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black, grey, and off-white to evoke antiquity and somberness. The background is obscured, highlighting the building within the frame.

artworks.title: Bibi Valentin
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Julius Garfinckel, 1938)
artworks.description: The image shows a young child in a relaxed seated pose. The child has a slight lean, with their head tilted and gazing straight ahead. The facial features are depicted with large eyes, a small nose, and medium-length hair. The child wears a loose-fitting outfit with long sleeves and a high collar. They are barefoot, with one leg extended forward and the other bent at the knee. The background is minimalistic with faint horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Thames Warehouses
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Josephine Boardman Crane, 1954)
artworks.description: The image displays a waterfront scene with ships docked at a wharf. The masts of the ships are visible along the horizon. People are seen on boats in the foreground, while larger ships and buildings populate the docking area. There is a plume of smoke in the distance, and the scene is depicted in a detailed, sketch-like style using a monochromatic color palette.
